P1.1.text: Resmed | The World Leader in Sleep Health

P1.2.text: From sleep apnea to respiratory conditions including COPD, Resmed has innovative solutions to help people live happier, healthier lives.

P1.3.text: Just ask our millions of users.

P1.4.text: At Resmed, we create life-changing health technologies that people love.

P1.5.text: The quietest nasal pillows mask on the market

P1.6.text: Three simple components. Just 1.6 oz. Nothing gets in the way of your sleep.

P1.8.text: Meet myAir: your 24/7 CPAP support app that makes it easier to get started and stay engaged with your therapy.

P1.9.text: Your path to better sleep starts here

P1.11.text: CPAP mask categories to suit the way you sleep

P1.12.text: Resmed CPAP mask categories are designed to reflect your needs and sleep habits. Our Versatile Fit, Freedom and Minimalist categories help make finding the right CPAP mask for you easier.

P1.13.text: See your progress and feel your momentum with the Streaks feature in myAir.™ Easily track your consecutive nights on CPAP and celebrate your milestones. Start your streak tonight and set new records.

P1.14.text: Our Residential Care Software team offers innovative, comprehensive software platforms that support healthcare providers in settings outside of the hospital.

P1.16.text: A family that sleeps better, lives better

P1.18.text: We’re here to help with tools and resources to help you as you start therapy.

P1.19.text: Find masks, devices and accessories you may need for your sleep apnea therapy.

P1.20.text: Our team is here to help answer your questions.

P1.21.text: Be among the first to hear all the latest news and developments.

P2.1.text: Sleep Apnea Test at Home | Home Sleep Testing Solutions

P2.2.text: NightOwl is a small, efficient sleep apnea test at home that offers 10 nights of recorded data for internight variability and an alternate to in-lab sleep tests

P2.3.text: Resmed diagnostic solutions are designed to help the millions of undiagnosed sleep apnea patients get answers they need, and the treatment they deserve so they can rest. Our Home Sleep Tests (HSTs) empower providers to screen more patients and manage each step of the diagnostic process.

P2.4.text: Fully disposable, non-invasive home sleep test – fits comfortably on a patient’s index finger

P2.5.text: Records up to 10 nights of data † to help provide an accurate picture of a patient’s sleep health

P2.6.text: Comes with an easy-to-follow companion app, myAir, that helps patients through each testing step

P2.7.text: Cloud-based home sleep test that automatically syncs patient data each morning to the provider portal

P2.8.text: Provides performance and reliability in a compact, lightweight, and easy-to-use device

P2.9.text: Records up to five channels of information: respiratory effort, pulse, oxygen saturation, nasal flow and snoring

P2.10.text: Works seamlessly with AirView™ to provide a comprehensive sleep diagnostic solution

P2.11.text: † Based on average use of 8 hours per night

P3.1.text: About Resmed | The World Leader in Sleep Health | Resmed

P3.2.text: Resmed is dedicated to developing innovative solutions to help people around the world sleep and breathe better.

P3.3.text: We work every day to help people sleep, breathe and live better.

P3.4.text: We’re leading the way in cloud-connected medical devices that transform care for people with sleep apnea, COPD and other chronic diseases. P1.3.text: At Accendra Health (formerly known as Owens & Minor, Inc.), care is a promise. A promise of peace of mind, a promise of confidence, and a commitment to connecting patients, providers, and insurers so healthcare works better for everyone.

P1.4.text: Backed by the industry-leading expertise of our Apria and Byram Healthcare brands, Accendra Health provides patients with critical products, services, and support to manage their health, helping to improve outcomes for millions of people each year.

P1.5.text: Reimagining the Future of Home-Based Care

P1.6.text: Accendra Health is reimagining the future of home-based care with one of the broadest portfolios of essentials for diabetes, sleep health, wound care, respiratory care, urology, and ostomy.

P1.7.text: Great care starts with our team. Here’s how we take care of you.

P1.8.text: Medical, dental, and vision care coverage

P1.9.text: Mental, physical, and financial well-being programs

P1.10.text: Stay Connected for the Latest News

P1.11.text: Visit our Newsroom for the latest news and updates from Accendra Health.

P2.2.text: Healthcare is complicated. Accendra Health makes it a little easier by Bringing Care To Life ™.

P2.3.text: At Accendra Health (formerly known as Owens & Minor, Inc.), care is a promise. A promise that gives healthcare professionals peace of mind that their patients can get the care they need. A promise offering confidence to people that they can manage their health and live life on their own terms. A commitment to connecting patients, providers, and insurers so healthcare works better for everyone.

P2.4.text: With deep expertise promoting health outside the hospital and a presence in communities nationwide through our Apria and Byram Healthcare brands, Accendra Health does more than just deliver the essentials. We overcome obstacles. We educate and provide answers. We make it possible for patients and families to access healthcare when and where they need it, helping to improve outcomes for millions of people each year who receive care at home.

P2.5.text: Healthcare is complicated, but Accendra Health is here to help make it a little easier. We focus on the details of bringing care into the home, empowering patients with critical products, services, and support so they can focus on the moments that matter most.

P2.6.text: At Accendra Health, our Purpose drives us. Bringing Care To Life ™ means meeting people where they are and delivering care that fits their lives beyond traditional settings.

P2.7.text: Our Mission is to provide innovative solutions that ensure patients get the care they need in the comfort of their homes.

P2.8.text: Our Vision is to be a leading partner in care for medical equipment, supplies, and solutions in the home for individuals, families, and caregivers.

P3.2.text: Two Trusted Names. One Bright Future.
